description: Any claim sealed on chain now and revealed later, a track record nobody can backdate. Send your claim as the payload string with an optional revealDelayHours from 1 to 720, default 72. Your identity is your paying wallet, or your key id. ChainHelix seals the exact time of your commitment on the opBNB chain; the claim text and salt publish automatically at reveal time. This attests WHEN you said it, never whether it is true. Verification spec: the free attest_spec tool. Price: 5 cents per call. A ChainHelix API key does not cover this tool.
name: attest
